## History

Stella Maynard was a former chum of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) who taught school after leaving. She maintained a correspondence with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), receiving letters detailing Anne's teaching experiences and her students' work. Stella later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their friends to live together at Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). During her time residing at Patty's Place, Stella engaged in house conversations about daily life, cheered up [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by reading dramatic stories from their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) during intense exam studying, and shared in her housemates' celebrations, romances, and graduation milestone.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Philippa Gordon! I never thought you were utterly unfeeling. The idea of you saying you’d love to break a man’s heart!"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who first met during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They live together at Patty's Place alongside their fellow housemates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), sharing daily domestic life, house duties, and celebrations such as Anne's literary success. During stressful periods of intense studying at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), they comfort each other, such as by reading dramatic childhood stories from their [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +15 more_

- Friend of — intimate Academy friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +3 more</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) have been intimate friends since attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. They live as roommates at Patty's Place during their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), sharing the house with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and their other companions. Together, they experience key milestones, including setting up their home, studying for exams, and celebrating their eventual graduation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), +11 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)
